latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of amg-check-pg-flex: a comprehensive fleet-wide PostgreSQL Flexible Server health checker for Azure.

- On-demand deep health scan: CPU, memory, storage, IOPS, disk bandwidth, and connection metrics across all servers.
- Automated detection and persistent tracking of abnormal servers, with in-depth log correlation and known-issue management.
- Distinct Tier 1 (pulse) and Tier 2 (deep dive) investigation phases using AMG-MCP and Azure Monitor.
- Auto-discovers the Azure Monitor datasource UID and prompts user for subscription on first run.
- Flexible time range and subscription overrides via arguments.
- Safety features: parallel query caps, timeout handling, large result streaming, and robust progress tracking.
